Dear friends,

Article "Homemade holograms" has been published in "Files" section of our web site. This article describes the simple holographic setup and processing, which allow to record small qualitative reflection holograms in domestic conditions. This article was presented on HOLOEXPO-2004 conference in October, 20.

See [http://www.holography.ru/files/holpte.htm](http://www.holography.ru/files/holpte.htm)

Please leave your inquiries in our forum ( [http://www.holography.ru/cgi-bin/ultimatebb.cgi](http://www.holography.ru/cgi-bin/ultimatebb.cgi) ) or send via e-mail, so we'll be able to respond shortly.
